properties.evidence: Its stated rule "THE RECEIPT IS THE TEST" is implemented as tools/reflow2_init.py:1979 (main) `if (project / STAMP).exists(): return None`, so update runs install() whenever .reflow2/kit-version.json exists, whatever is on disk; install() then writes the updating kit's full file list for the recorded harnesses, and place_kit_file (:2024) treats a missing file as one to create. Deletion is defined as acceptance: place_kit_file's own message says "delete the file to accept the kit copy" and tools/test_init.py:675 pins "Deleting the file accepts the kit copy on the next run". No state records "this project removed its kit". Measured: receipt present + kit deleted -> 72-76 files and 4 tracked files edited; receipt deleted -> refused, exit 1.
